resources.string: Lets Ghost Keyboard\'s Sherlock plugin read the chat on your screen when it drafts a reply for you. It reads when you open the keyboard in a chat or tap Reply and, only if you turn on Auto-reply, while a chat is open, to answer each new message for you and send it. The conversation goes to your own AI provider with your own key; nothing is kept. Auto-reply tells you each reply it sends, with Stop.
